figurative_meaning_en: Eyes bulging or popping out in astonishment
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবরটা শুনে তার চোখ চড়কগাছে ওঠে গেল।
এত বড় সারপ্রাইজ দেখে সবার চোখ চড়কগাছে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: His eyes popped out upon hearing the news.
Everyone's eyes bulged in astonishment at the surprise.
history: This idiom likely originates from rural Bengali village life, referencing the high swing (চড়কা) used in traditional fairs, symbolizing eyes widening to an extreme height in shock.
note: The idiom evokes imagery from pre-modern rural settings with traditional swings.
